description: This Dart file defines the AuthController class that manages authentication state, including login, logout, signup, and session initialization, using Flutter's ChangeNotifier for state management.

classes.name: AuthController
classes.description: A controller class managing user authentication state, handling login, signup, logout, and persistent session loading.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Loads stored session data from secure storage and updates internal state.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Auth method that logs in a user with email and password, updating session token and email.

methods.name: signup
methods.description: Creates a new user account and initializes session data with the returned token.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Clears the stored session and resets authentication state.

methods.name: isAuthed
methods.description: Checks whether there is an active, non-empty session token indicating the user is authenticated.
